oneLine: Maxivision files confidentially for an IPO, enabling early investor liquidity.

sources.title: Quadria-backed Maxivision confidentially files for India IPO

synopsis: Maxivision Super Specialty Eye Hospitals, backed by healthcare-focused buyout firm Quadria Capital, has confidentially filed for an initial public offering in India. The IPO will include a mix of newly issued shares and stock sold by existing investors. ICICI Securities and IIFL Capital have been appointed as bankers for the offering.
